title: Modddif — AI 3D Model Texturing and Refinement Toolkit
summary: Modddif is an AI-powered platform designed for texturing, refining, and cleaning up 3D models. It specializes in multi-view texture generation, texture in-painting, and the creation of PBR maps to improve raw AI-generated meshes.
research_notes: Commonly integrated into professional workflows as a post-processing step for assets generated by tools like Trellis or Tripo AI.

evolution.summary: Has transitioned from a basic texturing tool into a specialized refinement suite for 3D artists. Recent major updates include multi-view consistency support, targeted texture in-painting for specific mesh areas, and automated PBR segmentation.
